memory_candidates.content: In this repository, scripts/check-module-invariants.sh's --no-build flag skips C1/C2/C6/C16/C24/C25/C36b (every build-dependent check), including C2's axiom-baseline hard stop. When a task's plan explicitly names C2 as a hard stop to verify, --no-build is not a valid shortcut: the full run (with its own internal lake build + lake build BimodalTest) must be used, even under a Batch Gate Deferral directive, when the deferral's narrowing tools (run-all.sh --only, verify-deploy.sh --only-gate) do not cover the Lean-repo-specific check at all -- that is the deferral's own UNMAPPABLE CRITERION case, which says run the named check directly rather than treating partial coverage as satisfying it.

git-commit-phase.sh's --objective flag must be a single integer matching one objective id in the phase progress file's objectives[] array, never a combined range like "1-3". A combined-range value fails to match any objective, so files_touched derivation returns empty, the WARNING is printed, and the commit silently proceeds with only the fixed task-directory paths staged -- excluding the real source-file edits from that commit. Recovery: a direct git-commit-scoped.sh follow-up commit naming the omitted files explicitly. When multiple objectives complete together, call git-commit-phase.sh once per single objective id, or ensure the combined-objective's own id matches by using a different field, not a hyphenated range string.

lake-build-guard.sh's module scoping accepts multiple space-separated targets in one call (e.g. `-- build Mod1 Mod2 Mod3`), useful for scoping a batch-deferred build to every module a multi-phase task touched in one invocation rather than running the scoped guard once per module. Module names for a lean_lib with a non-default srcDir (e.g. BimodalTest with srcDir = "Tests") omit the srcDir prefix: the test file Tests/BimodalTest/Metalogic/LCExtensionTest.lean is addressed as BimodalTest.Metalogic.LCExtensionTest, not Tests.BimodalTest.Metalogic.LCExtensionTest.
